summary: Iteration 21 — Verified all 11 runtime-bug fixes from the cleanup pass. Created /app/backend/tests/test_cleanup_iteration_21.py with 13 tests covering the complaint char-validator, DISCORD_ORDER_WEBHOOK import (payment-screenshot + status update), Path import (SMTP settings), google_sheets_service import (order flow triggers customer sync), PromoCode model, LlmChat/UserMessage import (chat endpoint), SiteSettingsUpdate validators, health endpoint, and full order-create regression. So the 'live runtime bugs' claim is verified — remaining lint items are cosmetic.

The NameError is fixed, but the credentials remain invalid; every order emits an ERROR log line. Recommend rotating the service account key or gating the sync behind a feature flag.
